title: Payment confirmations delayed
summary: payments-worker confirmation delay increased while request traffic remained stable

logs: payments-worker WARN message handler retrying: downstream risk-api returned 429
deployments: risk-api rate-limit policy changed at 14:06Z from 1000/min to 100/min
payments-worker v3.4.1 deployed two days earlier

runbooks.title: Consumer queue backlog
runbooks.content: When queue depth rises and consumer throughput falls while producer rate is stable, inspect downstream throttling and retry backoff. Restore safe rate limits before scaling consumers.

oracle.root_cause: The risk-api rate limit was reduced to 100 requests per minute, throttling payments-worker and creating a confirmation queue backlog.
